productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Inspected exact GitHub main source SHA 66b3eefaeae7f9f136a98fdef08e1cba2ecfb742 on 2026-11-15 as the DEV comparison baseline. chosenApproach: System-admin-only Expo web/native route; read-only view over canonical Finance V3 and existing withdrawal RPC. Navigate to existing authority for mutations.
preserveBehaviors: No new tables, allocation math, authentication pathways or payout switches
Member QMP/Points remain non-cash without finalized funded settlement
Server-side RLS/RPC authority unchanged; no payout destination export
No change to BUKLOD Main ads, video, Community, Connect, health, Kingdom or native SDK/runtime
acceptanceChecks: Manila month selection and refresh reject stale RPC results
Export CSV formula-injection guarded and capped
TypeScript and Expo web export pass on exact PR SHA before any publish
alternativeApproaches: Parallel FIS database rejected: conflicts with Finance V3 source of truth
Separate Expo app with duplicate Supabase auth rejected due to cost, repeated login and account isolation
Auto-finalization/withdrawal activation rejected without evidence and independent server gates

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Introduce a separately routed canonical finance read-only screen and admin navigation without touching existing app runtime or financial writes.
preservedBehaviors: System Administrator role gating, single canonical finance snapshot, existing Expo route and all other modules unchanged.

selectionRationale: Existing Finance V3 authoritative RPC already provides reconciled bookkeeping, monthly close controls and payouts; a read-only Expo admin module is cheaper and safer than a new backend, app or ledger. The new route reuses current protected auth and does not create any monetary write permissions.
